scores.tell: Glossy plastic sheen on DJ body and headphones; hot-spot highlights a bit sharp, very round inflated forms
Chair metal legs have slightly chrome-glossy highlights; soft cast shadow is fine, fabric shading smooth
Fuzzy velvet-like cat with soft shading, but the ground shadow is weak and form is a bit plush/airbrushed, a little too soft and realistic
Faceted star shaded in clean bands with soft sheen; slight gem glint, minimal tell
Smooth metallic gradients on lamp body and truss look rendered; beam is a translucent smear with no cast light
Wood doors shaded smoothly with soft contact shadow; shadow under the frame is a little flat and the form turn is simple
Glass mask has glossy streak highlights and translucent shading; wood planks are slightly texture-heavy
Telescope with soft broad sheen and a smooth turn into shadow; the lens glint is slightly hard
Soft form shading on trunk and fronds with a gentle cast shadow; fronds have slightly strong dark creases
Stone looks realistic-textured with veining; it is flatter than the real cards, with weak, uniform contact shadow
